title: Fuel cost per gallon rose as consumption fell
question: Was the larger fuel bill associated with a higher reported cost per gallon or with consuming more fuel?
comparability_limits: Reported per-gallon fuel cost including tax is USD 3.92 versus USD 2.40; fuel consumed is 548 versus 554 million gallons; fuel expense and related taxes is USD 2,152 million versus USD 1,331 million.

Use the cost-per-gallon measure including fuel tax, not the separate unhedged measure. Taxes, terminated-contract premium expense, accounting and rounding prevent presenting this as a pure spot jet-fuel price series.
Rates are not additive and are not an exact multiplicative reconciliation of the nominal expense line. No fuel-price elasticity, EPS sensitivity or forecast bridge is inferred.
These are completed-quarter observations, not the later quarter's fuel outcome. Any company forward-curve assumption must retain its separate as-of date and forecast status.

Mobile layout: three horizontal rows with a visible zero baseline, one shared linear percentage axis and one-decimal signed labels; distinguish the small negative consumption bar with its label rather than rescaling it independently.

points.period: Fuel cost per gallon, including tax
